meta.name: HybridDriveSettings
meta.description: Hybrid or range-extended vehicle driving settings. Adds energy-use strategy selection and queries of actual engine and electric-drive operating states, distinguishing user requests from the actual strategy under protection conditions. Instantiate only for vehicle models equipped with both fuel and electric energy systems. Range-extender generation does not imply that the engine directly drives the wheels.

requested_energy_strategy.description: Identifier of the most recently accepted energy-use strategy request. An empty string means no strategy has been requested.

effective_energy_strategy.description: Energy-use strategy currently applied by the simulated powertrain. It may differ from requested_energy_strategy while protection_active is true.

configured_energy_strategies.description: Read-only vehicle-model configuration keyed by selectable energy-strategy identifier. Each record declares whether the strategy favors electric energy, balances both energy systems, or favors engine use.

protection_active.description: Whether a simulated powertrain protection condition currently overrides the requested energy-use strategy.

protection_strategy.description: Read-only configured energy strategy applied whenever protection_active is true. Its value is always a key in configured_energy_strategies.

engine_operating_state.description: Actual simulated engine operating state supplied by powertrain feedback. Generating electricity does not imply mechanical drive to the wheels.

electric_drive_operating_state.description: Actual simulated electric-drive operating state supplied by powertrain feedback, independent of the requested energy strategy.

get_requested_energy_strategy.description: Return the most recently accepted energy-use strategy request without changing state.

requested_energy_strategy.description: Requested configured energy-strategy identifier, or an empty string when none has been requested.

get_effective_energy_strategy.description: Return the energy-use strategy currently applied by the simulated powertrain without changing state.

get_energy_strategy_configuration.description: Return the fixed configuration for one available energy-use strategy. An unknown strategy identifier is rejected without changing state.

strategy_configuration.description: Fixed strategy record containing its energy_bias.

errorcodes.PRECONDITION_FAILED: The requested energy-use strategy is not configured for this vehicle model.

get_protection_active.description: Return whether a simulated powertrain protection condition is currently overriding the requested energy-use strategy.

protection_active.description: Whether protection-based strategy override is active.

get_protection_strategy.description: Return the configured energy-use strategy applied while protection_active is true.

get_engine_operating_state.description: Return the actual simulated engine operating state. A generating_electricity result does not establish a mechanical connection between the engine and the wheels.

engine_operating_state.description: Actual engine state: off, idling, generating_electricity, or propelling_vehicle.

get_electric_drive_operating_state.description: Return the actual simulated electric-drive operating state without inferring it from the requested energy strategy.

electric_drive_operating_state.description: Actual electric-drive state: inactive, propelling_vehicle, or regenerating.

select_energy_strategy.description: Select an energy-use strategy configured for this vehicle model. The accepted strategy is always stored in requested_energy_strategy. When protection_active is false, it also becomes effective_energy_strategy; when protection_active is true, effective_energy_strategy remains the configured protection_strategy. The operation does not infer or modify actual engine or electric-drive operating states and does not set speed or gear. Unknown identifiers are rejected before any state change.

semantics.reason: The effective strategy is conditionally assigned from either the accepted request or the configured protection strategy.

errorcodes.PRECONDITION_FAILED: The requested energy-use strategy is not configured for this vehicle model.

report_powertrain_status.description: Atomically ingest simulated powertrain feedback. The supplied protection condition and actual engine and electric-drive operating states replace the previous feedback. When protection_active is true, effective_energy_strategy becomes protection_strategy. When protection_active is false and a requested strategy exists, that request becomes effective; when no request exists, the configured protection strategy remains the deterministic baseline. This feedback operation does not change requested_energy_strategy, select a driving mode, set vehicle speed or gear, or imply that electricity generation mechanically drives the wheels. Invalid input leaves all state unchanged.

protection_active.description: Whether a powertrain protection condition currently overrides the requested energy-use strategy.

semantics.reason: This operation atomically records a feedback bundle and conditionally reconciles the effective strategy from the protection strategy or the previously accepted user request.

errorcodes.INVALID_INPUT_ERROR: Protection status and both operating states must use the declared types and choices; invalid feedback leaves all state unchanged.
